text:
lee: quick async update — pushed jwt-rotator fix to staging and ran routing policy smoke tests. saw a small uptick in 429s for short bursts (~2%). attaching initial logs.

sasha: which commit/PR? can you drop the smoke logs in the PR thread? also pinging infra if autoscale might be related.

lee: PR #8123 — logs here: https://staging.ci/redwood/logs/8123. repro: `make smoke-test --burst=50 --concurrency=8` (ran 3x). snippet from the smoke runner:
```
# smoke run
burst=50
concurrency=8
observed: 2.1% 429 @ p95 latency 180ms
```

devin: thanks — I'll triage autoscaler and queue lengths. @infra-team can you confirm if any node churn happened during the runs?

maria: fyi i bumped the default global rate policy to 200r/s last night for a short experiment; i rolled it back in staging when I saw noise. could be interacting with short-burst behavior.

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: rotator-2025-07-14-staging :rocket:

sasha: blocker for prod canary — want to make sure the 429s are stable before we promote. if we can root cause quickly we can do a limited canary (5% traffic) tomorrow.

lee: plan for today: 1) run smoke tests with and without KV cache warm; 2) add a separate dashboard panel for burst 429 rate; 3) draft a canary runbook (if stable).

devin: i'll check autoscaler metrics (queue depth, pod spin-up latency) and the batching config. quick idea: if continuous batching threshold is too high for short requests we might be delaying small bursts into bigger batches causing transient queueing.

maria: i'll attach the perf graphs and the rate-policy diff to the PR in a sec. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lee: if no major surprises i'll schedule a 5% canary tomorrow 10:00am PT. can folks 👍 or mention objections here?

sasha: 👍

devin: leaning yes; i'll raise an incident ticket if the autoscaler shows sustained lag during the canary.

maria: no objections. i'll stand by to revert rate-policy if needed.

lee: thanks all — will post smoke-test results and canary runbook in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
__notes: This is a single-thread Slack export style JSON: messages in chronological order, short-form, includes bot message and inline code block. No title field per agents.md rules.
